summary: Lincoln County, MT crow's nest dated to the 1920s, later abandoned; FFLA lists it Abandoned, not gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as Abandoned; firelookout.com says abandoned with no date. Neither source calls it gone.

evidence.supports: type crowsnest; coordinates 48.95217 north, 115.86198 west; status Abandoned
firelookout.com: abandoned, no date; not gone

corrections.why: The FFLA Montana list gives the status Abandoned, not Gone, and no source read calls the site gone.

notes_for_editor: Only the firelookout.com page and one FFLA row exist. One WebSearch found the same firelookout.com page; a search for the Yaak area returned Yaak Mountain Lookout, a different tower, which is not cited. The only date is 1920s, so no built event is recorded; an editor may want a decade field. Elevation 5,626 ft is in the source and could fill the record's elevation_m, which is null. Access and visit are left out because no source covers them.
